hint: WASD to walk  ·  E to look at something  ·  the track out is south

spots.line: Bundles of something dried hang low enough to walk into.
A hedge grown into a wall, and a gap in it that was made on purpose.
Bones, arranged. Small ones. Whoever did it was not in a hurry.

chests.line: A jar wedged in the roots, and something rattling in it.

people.name: Grelda of the Hedge
chatter: You came the long way. Everyone does. There isn't a short one.
I don't sell anything. People keep leaving coin anyway.
Don't touch the small bones. The big ones are fine.
It'll rain by dark. It always rains by dark out here.

people.name: a wolf that will not come closer
chatter: It watches from the hedge line and does not come any nearer.
